visualCharacteristics.purpose: Bordered data table with header row inside a text column
visualCharacteristics.layout: Bordered, centred cells, scrolls sideways below 768px; definitions is a term/definition grid

contentPattern.structure: one row per table row, one cell per column; the first row is the header row

reuseGuidance: Reuse table for the same content pattern on newly migrated pages; add an option class rather than forking for small visual differences.
